Evidence/CLM-046
Evidence record

Pledge, agreement, deposit and disbursement are different stages of support

What does this evidence establish?

Saudi support is recorded by financial state. A pledge, commitment, signed agreement, deposited amount, amount made available, budget disbursement, FX-auction use, in-kind support and project cost are not interchangeable, and they are not added into a cumulative total here.

What does it measure?

This record sets out a distinction and reports no value: a pledge, commitment, signed agreement, deposit, amount made available, budget disbursement, use in foreign-exchange auctions, in-kind support and project cost are different stages of Saudi support to Yemen.

Who or what does it apply to?

Source/package-specific

When was it measured or observed?

2010–2026

How current is it?

The evidence in this record spans 2010 to 2026. It should not be read as describing later support unless newer evidence is published.

What this evidence does not establish

Adding unlike or overlapping stages does not produce a cumulative total of Saudi support, and no such total is established here.

Limits of the measure

No single, fully reconciled public ledger of the flows exists; larger packages and their components, and the commitment, deposit, availability, disbursement and use stages, can overlap.

Method and verification detailAdditional detail for reproducing or challenging the reading without changing the evidence meaning.

How was it produced?

Evidence from donor and multilateral sources, read with AidData's historical method for classifying Saudi support to Yemen; the stages are kept separate and are not added together.
